title: Sunday · the Driftwood from 101
logline: A landscape Sunday. The motel from the highway at dawn, end of shift. The sign. The wet-on-wet arrives.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the Driftwood Motel from across 101 at dawn, wet-on-wet watercolor at last: a low L of rooms, a sign on a pole — DRIFTWOOD MOTEL · VACANCY — the neon pale in the gray, fog on the ridge behind, one car.

image.prompt: a low L-shaped roadside motel across a coastal highway at dawn in wet-on-wet watercolor, a sign on a pole with pale neon, fog on the ridge behind, one parked car, gray-green and rust
image.notes: Sign: DRIFTWOOD MOTEL · VACANCY. Letter after. The wet-on-wet Sundays begin.

panels.name: Vacancy

panels.composition: Tier 2: the lobby door from outside, the desk lamp still on inside, a figure in a polo getting up.

image.prompt: a motel lobby's glass door seen from outside at dawn with a desk lamp still lit within and a figure in a polo rising from the desk, watercolor

panels.name: Shift end

panels.composition: Tier 3: the highway, north, the man walking the shoulder home in the polo with the pad under his arm, the fog lifting off the ridge in one place — a glow there, small, that the composition treats as weather.

image.prompt: a man in a maroon polo walking the shoulder of a coastal highway at dawn with a pad under his arm, fog lifting from a forested ridge where one patch glows faintly, wet-on-wet watercolor, no words
image.notes: The ridge glow, second appearance after 'Lanes' 2009. Treated as weather.

panels.name: Home

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The first true wet-on-wet Sunday. The ridge glow returns, small, in fog.
